basic_info.description: Here is the urban residence that you've been waiting for! Welcome to #1205, a rare high-floor Symphony Towers one bedroom condominium. This bright corner unit is perfect for full-time living, a second residence or even a pied-a-terre. The big windows in the living room and bedroom showcase the northern & western views of the city skyline and urban hillsides. There's even a peek-a-boo view of the Transamerica Pyramid. The floor plan is open with a combination living/dining room, seating at the breakfast bar and a cozy desk nook. The kitchen features granite counters and stainless steel appliances including a gas range, dishwasher, built-in microwave and refrigerator. Additional upgrades are hardwood floors throughout, a glass tub enclosure, in-unit washer/dryer and built-in closet systems. Parking for one vehicle in the underground garage is included, plus additional storage in the building. The building offers a common-area roof deck with outdoor kitchen/BBQ area and seating. Centrally located near City Hall, the Opera House, Davies Symphony Hall, SF Ballet, multiple shopping & restaurant options and easy transportation choices. Scores: Walk=99; Transit=100; Bike=94 Motivated Seller!
